newsitem.title: CHINA: Malaysia electronics sector to improve - Rafidah.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia electronics sector to improve - Rafidah.

text.p: Malaysia's Minister of International Trade and Industry, Rafidah Aziz, said on Wednesday that the downturn in the country's electronics sector had slowed.
"The scenario is that we are seeing now already the levelling off of any downturn for us," Rafidah told a news conference.
A world-wide slump in demand for electronics products has had a significant impact on Malaysia, which is a major exporter of computer chips.
But she added Malaysian companies had anticipated the downturn and had prepared for it by restructuring.
"Frankly speaking, we did not see a massive curtailment of our electronic sector exports," said Rafidah, who is attending the 32nd World Congress of the International Chamber of Commerce in Shanghai.
"There has been a decrease but not to the extent that some countries are facing," she said.
